Explicit package/connector return sensitivity, not extracted measured shared package model

limits: The 3nH shared-return and simultaneous-current waveform are sensitivity assumptions, not the complete ESP32-P4/GW2A package IBIS power model.
The strong ideal-current stress exceeds supply compliance: its multi-volt ringing is a model-domain warning, not a prediction that real chip ground will reach that voltage.
Input thresholds and local supply references move with package ground; figures are not simply added as independent worst-case noise guarantees.
